title: Every odd antihole is strongly chromatic-choosable
description:
The paper proves strong chromatic-choosability for every odd antihole and deduces the extremal odd-antihole characterization in odd-hole-free critical graphs.

Submission package revision. The supplied Lean development proves the main antihole theorem and its supporting path, cycle and list-colouring lemmas. The critical-graph consequence in Section 6 is a written proof and is not formalised. The successful prior repository CI is recorded in verification/previous-ci.json; no new local Lean rebuild is claimed by this package.
